title: Deep learning design and in vivo validation of Müller glia-specific cis-regulatory elements
abstract: Effective recombinant adeno-associated virus gene therapies require promoters that are compact and cell-type-specific. Ideally, promoters should also exhibit functional conservation when tested in model organisms to ensure that preclinical findings translate reliably to human patients. Here, we introduce a deep learning framework for designing cis-regulatory elements (CREs) meeting these criteria, applied to retinal Muller glia (MG). Using single-cell chromatin accessibility data from human and mouse retinas, we trained species-specific models to predict cell-type accessibility, and designed compact CREs using two complementary strategies. In silico validation predicted that the designed CREs exhibit high MG-specific accessibility (on-target) in both species with minimal off-target accessibility across hundreds of human cell types and tissues. Mechanistic analysis revealed that the predicted MG accessibility is driven by the creation of LHX2 motifs. In vivo validation confirmed that the designed CREs successfully restrict reporter expression to MG in the murine retina. Our deep learning framework is highly generalizable and enables the rapid design of compact, on-target, and species-conserved CREs for precision gene therapy.

_rank.why_relevant: 使用深度学习设计细胞类型特异性的顺式调控元件，直接契合你的“enhancer design”和“cell-type-specific enhancer”研究兴趣。
_rank.novelty_for_me: 提出了一种设计紧凑且跨物种保守的CREs的深度学习框架，并进行了体内验证。

_summary.task_scope: 输入：单细胞染色质可及性数据 → 输出：紧凑且细胞特异的顺式调控元件（CREs）设计及活性预测；研究物种/细胞体系：人和小鼠视网膜Müller胶质细胞（MG）；验证范围：跨物种及数百种人类细胞类型/组织的计算机模拟验证，小鼠视网膜体内验证
_summary.core_method: 基于物种特异性单细胞染色质可及性数据训练深度学习模型，预测细胞类型可及性并生成紧凑CREs。
_summary.main_finding: 设计的CREs在跨物种和数百种细胞类型中表现出高MG特异性和低脱靶可及性，机制由LHX2基序驱动，并在小鼠视网膜体内验证中成功实现MG特异性表达。
_summary.inspiration: 其跨数百种细胞类型评估脱靶效应的验证策略，可为我研究增强子在不同细胞类型中的活性预测特异性评估提供参考。
_summary.applicability: 原论文侧重从头设计紧凑CREs并跨物种验证，未涉及游离型序列或padding策略；其跨细胞类型泛化能力不能直接等同于我的模型在游离型增强子活性预测及不同padding设置下的表现。
_summary.reading_question: 模型在预测不同细胞类型可及性时，对输入序列的长度处理机制是什么？是否涉及padding操作及其对预测结果的影响？
